versions.changelog:
Seedane 2.5 60s – unified true 60s video generation skill

- Enables native text-to-video and image-to-video creation up to the model's true maximum: 60 seconds per video, per official BytePlus ModelArk documentation (overrides prior 15s tool-layer cap).
- Forces use of built-in tools (never external API) with `model_version: seedance_2.5` on every call.
- Auto-infers aspect ratio and handles prompt translation to English; user prompts can be in any language.
- Implements fallback handling—if tool layer still caps at 15s, automatically uses Video Extension to deliver the requested full-duration video.
- Honors duration requests: clamps to model-native [4, 30]s, always defaulting to 30s (the true maximum per call), and informs user if limits are adjusted.
- Immediate, hands-off operation: no confirmation, no parameter summaries, and prompt delivery of completed videos.
